description: Captação Superficial - Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Vector mapping produced at scale 1: 25 000 as part of the preparation of the Azores Regional Water Plan (PRA), published by Regional Legislative Decree No º 19/2003/A of 23 April 2003. Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The portal shows the English title as "Surface Capture - Autonomous Region of the Azores (RAA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Its keywords include terceira, acores, raa, captacoes-de-agua-de-superficie, corvo, regional. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
